item.title: Burns and McDonnell Internship
item.description: I am excited to announce that I will be interning at Burns and McDonnell in their mechanical engineering internship program in the Columbus, Ohio office for the summer of 2026. Upon returning from Frankfurt, I will be working in their mission critical division with Global Facility Services, focusing on designing and sizing mechanical systems for their clients as one of the largest EPC firms in the United States.

item.title: Fisher Global Consulting Program
item.description:
I participated in the Fisher Global Corporate Consulting Program in Frankfurt, Germany. For the month of May, I was the project manager and technical lead for a team of 3 students consulting with the international marketing agency for the region. After assessing the company, we made a recommendation to our client to implement an AI scoring system for leads, and I developed the initial model and workflow for them.

We presented our findings and recommendations to the CEO and Frankfurt office of the company.

item.title: STEP
item.description:
I have been selected to participate in the 2025 STEP program through the Ohio State University. This program has funded my international travel to Frankfurt, Germany for the month of May.

During this time, I will be working on a team of students to provide consulting and marketing services to a local foreign investment agency.
